latest_outbound_link_report.note: Existing build gate results; this does not replace direct HTTP redirect tests.

interpretation_notes: This is configuration inventory, not end-to-end redirect validation.
Every current registry theme is represented; current DNS/Pages totals were checked sequentially against API-reported totals.
Missing DNS entries and Pages deployments without registry paths are flagged for review; don't redirect blindly.
The active redirect rules are selective by request method, path extension, user-agent, API path, and specific FCG/Research exceptions; inspect the condition before editing.
Direct HTTP response status/final URL/content-type tests for all eligible old hosts and new paths remain outstanding.
D1 metadata inspection was read-only and queried table names only, not application rows.
validation_notes: Do not confuse the Pages project's latest deployment pointer (which may reference a preview) with the recorded production deployment ID in source.production_deployment.

existing_storage.interpretation: Read-only schema metadata only; no application rows were read. Store ownership and catalogue synchronization remain to be documented.

central_evidence_catalogue.location: static build output split into SQLite chunks and a content-addressed blob store
central_evidence_catalogue.distinction: The static catalogue is not a writable application database; server-side app stores are separate.

architecture_observation.unresolved: Cross-app synchronization, canonical evidence IDs/API, schema compatibility/versioning and full theme-to-database ownership remain not yet tested.

live_remediation.scope: GET/HEAD HTML and extensionless routes; API paths, agent paths, .well-known paths, two protected user-agent classes, and pre-existing FCG/Research path exceptions retained.
live_remediation.rollback: Restore the saved rule baseline in reports/cedwyn-migration-rollback.json; delete the story CNAME by record ID c2b5c21cc178c8b72572fa2320cd1a9d if reverting the new host alias.

post_change_audit.scope: Root/index and declared service endpoint smoke tests for all 44 registered canonical paths, 39 mapped legacy app hosts, 25 machine endpoints and two extra FCG synonyms.
post_change_audit.limitation: This does not exhaustively crawl all nested routes, file assets, downloads, media-specific hosts or all 179 Worker routes. 26 Pages projects currently have custom domains not directly registered as theme domains; classify those as app, media, alias or service before claiming full site-wide retirement.
